resources.string: Tap Stream screen and allow the capture: the MMI shows this phone\'s screen, up to Max fps pictures a second (the MMI may manage fewer). Format: H.264 is smooth video decoded by the MMI\'s video chip (Android 10+, about half a second behind); JPEG is a few pictures a second decoded by the MMI\'s CPU. Latency clock: a big running clock here; a photo of the phone and the MMI together shows how far the MMI is behind. Switch to any app, turn the phone, unplug and replug: the streaming carries on until you stop it here or from its notification. Locking the phone ends it; Keep screen on stops the screen timing out and locking by itself (it may dim, the MMI\'s picture stays bright).
